name: What types of materials are used for sliding door thresholds and their repair?

mainEntity.name: What types of materials are used for sliding door thresholds and their repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sliding door thresholds are commonly made from wood (often treated for weather resistance), aluminum, vinyl, or composite materials. When repairing, contractors select materials that match the existing threshold or offer improved durability and weather resistance. Repairs may involve using wood fillers, epoxy, sealants, or replacement sections made from suitable materials to ensure longevity and proper function.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common materials are wood, aluminum, vinyl, or composite. Repairs use fillers, epoxy, sealants, or matching replacement sections for durability.
